categories.name: ERC 404
categories.content: ERC-404 is an experimental token standard that aims to bridge fungible tokens and NFTs to enable liquidity and fractionalization.

categories.name: SPL22
categories.content: SPL22 is a hybrid token extension of the Solana blockchain that combines the features of both fungible and non-fungible tokens.

categories.name: Reddit Points
categories.content: Reddit Community Points are blockchain tokens that are owned and controlled by a specific Reddit community. With these point tokens, a community member can own a piece of their favorite subreddit. The points can be earned through contributions in the community such as post creation, comments, and content moderations.

categories.name: Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed
categories.content: The Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed category features community-driven assets representing specific agent personas or viral narratives (memes) within the Moltbook platform.

categories.name: Virtual Reality
categories.content: Virtual reality (VR) uses computer-generated environments to create a simulated experience for users.

categories.name: Zodiac-Themed
categories.content: Meme coins related to zodiac signs.

categories.name: Wormhole Assets
categories.content: The Wormhole project is a bidirectional, decentralized SPL token bridge between Solana and EVM chains.

categories.name: America.fun Launchpad
categories.content: America.fun is the first USD1-native launchpad on Solana, designed to build a secure, 'American Dream' themed ecosystem for fair-launch tokens.

categories.name: Pools Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through Pools (https://pools.trade/), Uniswap's first-party token issuance platform.

categories.name: Ondo Intelligent Portfolios
categories.content: Single-token portfolio products issued by Ondo Finance that bundle multiple tokenized assets into one on-chain instrument. Each portfolio packages a themed basket that is drawn from Ondo's tokenized equities, ETFs, and in some cases crypto assets.

categories.name: Yoink.fun Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through Yoink (https://yoinkai.fun/), an agentic launch and trading terminal on Robinhood Chain.

categories.name: Olympus Pro Ecosystem
categories.content: Olympus Pro designed to provide liquidity management solutions for DeFi protocols. They offers a service called "bonds-as-a-service," which allows protocols to own their liquidity by offering discounted OHM tokens in exchange for liquidity provider (LP) tokens. This helps protocols to reduce their reliance on liquidity mining incentives and gain more control over their liquidity.

categories.name: Bank-Issued Stablecoin
categories.content: Fiat-pegged stablecoins issued by a regulated bank or a bank's dedicated subsidiary, structured as a claim on a segregated reserve pool or as electronic money but not as a bank deposit. Tokens are pegged 1:1 to a fiat currency and fully backed by ring-fenced reserve assets (cash and high-quality liquid assets) held off the bank's lending balance sheet, typically bankruptcy-remote from the issuer, with redemption at par. Unlike tokenized deposits, holders are not depositors of the bank: the token is a reserve-backed or e-money claim, generally non-interest-bearing, issued under a stablecoin or e-money regime (e.g., MiCA EMT in the EU, GENIUS Act payment stablecoins in the US) rather than deposit/banking law.

categories.name: Christmas Themed
categories.content: Meme coins themed around Christmas, inspired by holiday traditions, symbols, and celebrations.

categories.name: RWAfi
categories.content: Protocols whose core product is DeFi functionality built on top of tokenized real-world assets issued by third parties. Where RWA Protocols handle issuance, these protocols take an already-tokenized asset as input and make it financially productive: separating an asset's yield from its principal, lending against it as collateral, providing or managing its liquidity, constructing baskets from it, or routing value into it. Protocols in this category represent a claim on protocol activity and are not themselves backed by real-world assets.

categories.name: Fighting Games
categories.content: Fighting game centered around combat between two or more number of characters.

categories.name: Cookie Launchpad
categories.content: Cookie Launchpad is a token sale platform operated by Cookie DAO that allocates participation opportunities in three pools: one for top users ranked by on-chain and social engagement ('capital mindshare' via Cookie Snaps), one for $COOKIE token stakers in higher tiers, and a public first-come-first-served pool.

categories.name: Shooting Games
categories.content: Shooting games allow players to engage in combat by shooting enemies and objects. They can be presented in various perspectives including first-person or third-person views.
